manifest.name: UI Portability Lab (Prototype)
manifest.description: Local static UI snapshots with safe preview and omission reports. ChatGPT integration remains blocked.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'

popup: CDP Extensions.triggerAction on real toolbar tab, Runtime evaluation of actual popup DOM; no permission mocks
